allow: PowerShell(Get-Process | Where-Object { $_.ProcessName -match 'cargo|rustc|link|epubicus' } | Select-Object Id, ProcessName, StartTime, CPU | Format-Table -AutoSize)
PowerShell(Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -Filter "ProcessId = 999999" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; "---"; tasklist /FI "PID eq 999999" /FO CSV /NH 2>&1; "---"; "exit code: $LASTEXITCODE")
PowerShell($out = & cmd /c "tasklist /FI `"PID eq 999999`" /FO CSV /NH 2>nul"; "STDOUT START"; $out; "STDOUT END"; "len: $\($out.Length\)")
